title: Law to make schools report Medicaid reimbursement data
summary: This bill would require the Department of Education to report quarterly on Medicaid-eligible student health services, including how many were billed, reimbursed, denied or unclaimed, and why claims were not submitted. The data would be broken down citywide, by borough and by school district, and posted on the department's website. Student privacy would be protected by masking small or identifying categories.
